newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air France cargo chief leaves company.
newsitem.headline: Air France cargo chief leaves company.

text.p: Air France said its cargo director, Sten Grotenfelt, had left the company in the past few days.
"Air France will probably be issuing a statement on Grotenfelt's departure later today," an airline official told Reuters.

"He was appointed (in 1994) to revamp Air France's cargo activities and under his leadership the division has made a satisfactory recovery following the low point of end-1993 when a three-week strike took place. His mission can be seen as completed," a company source added.
There had been no conflict within the division or within the Air France group to provoke Grotenfelt's departure, the source added.
Grotenfelt joined Air France in June 1994 from the Luxembourg-based all cargo airline Cargolux where he had been president and chief executive.
Francois Bachelet, Air France Cargo's Strategy director and formerly Europe director, had replaced Grotenfelt, effective January 10, Air France added.
